component.name: Frostnotes
component.summary: Sync the Markdown notes your editor writes

description.p: Frostnotes keeps folders of plain Markdown notes in sync between your computers, through a hub that you host yourself. It has no window: you edit the notes with any editor of Markdown files, Obsidian among them, and notesd, the service inside this app, syncs what the editor writes.

The service watches each vault folder, keeps a search index with links, backlinks, tags and properties, keeps every version of a note for 30 days, and never writes over an edit it has not seen. The desktop starts it at login.
The hub, the same notesd on a server such as one in lodge, merges concurrent edits without conflict copies, and lodge serves a web app over its notes.

You set it up with the notesctl command: register a folder as a vault, pair this computer with the hub, and sync the vault with the hub's. notesctl and its MCP server also give scripts and agents the notes.
